album.title: The Mirza Abdollah Radif for Tar and Setar, Vol. 7

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C4 and dwells most on C in Naghme. The line peaks at C5 (516.2 Hz) at 0:12.6. It closes on the tonic (F3 → G3 → F3 → C4 → F3 → F3).

theory_fit.name: Farhat interval classes

flags: tonic F set in the catalog (the Rast-Panjgah suite's finalis F: Daramad II and ten gushe-ha end on it; read from it the suite has Rast's leading tone (the 2nd below, 4% of played time), which the other candidate, its 5th C, lacks (0.3%); Farhat 1990, pp. 100-101. Borumand's Nava on the same volume sits a tone above it, as in Farhat's keys; the vote picked the 5th. Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 258.0 Hz (C)
